list.name: server
list.label: Server
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, server_id AS __value FROM config.config_monitored_servers WHERE is_enabled ORDER BY name
list.description: Monitored SQL Server instance, from Darling's fleet registry.

list.name: wait_type
list.label: Wait type
list.query:
SELECT ws.wait_type
FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
  AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY ws.wait_type
ORDER BY SUM(ws.delta_wait_time_ms) DESC
list.definition:
SELECT ws.wait_type
FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
  AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY ws.wait_type
ORDER BY SUM(ws.delta_wait_time_ms) DESC
list.description: Wait types collected over the window, heaviest first. All plots the top 20.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ws.server_id,
        srv.name AS server_label,
        ws.wait_type
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
    JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = ws.server_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
      AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['*'] OR ws.wait_type = ANY(ARRAY[${wait_type:sqlstring}]))
    GROUP BY ws.server_id, srv.name, ws.wait_type
    ORDER BY SUM(ws.delta_wait_time_ms) DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        r.server_label,
        ws.wait_type,
        ws.collection_time,
        ws.delta_wait_time_ms,
        ws.delta_signal_wait_time_ms,
        ws.delta_waiting_tasks,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', ws.collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(ws.collection_time) OVER (
                PARTITION BY ws.server_id, ws.wait_type
                ORDER BY ws.collection_time)))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
    JOIN ranked AS r
      ON r.server_id = ws.server_id
     AND r.wait_type = ws.wait_type
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
      AND ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    server_label || ' - ' || wait_type AS metric,
    CASE
        WHEN interval_seconds > 0
        THEN delta_wait_time_ms::double precision / interval_seconds
        ELSE 0
    END AS value
FROM windowed
ORDER BY 1
